ArtifactEnvelope.description: Common envelope for every artifact response (artifacts.md §2).
ArtifactEnvelope.title: VS-01 artifact envelope (artifacts.md §2)

AssemblyLine.description: One line per definition and layer in use, the framing layer's fill included (D070, D082; ART-003 §7.1).
AssemblyLine.title: AssemblyLine

AssemblyOpeningRow.description: No position (ART-003 §4.3): positions belong to the views.
AssemblyOpeningRow.title: AssemblyOpeningRow

DeclaredValue.description: A declared property value with its provenance (D071, D075). The unit is fixed by the field name, in SI.
DeclaredValue.title: DeclaredValue

DefinitionLayer.description: A layer as stored, with its material's name and, for the framing layer, its framing by section label.
DefinitionLayer.title: DefinitionLayer

MeshConnection.description: A connection marker: where it is and what type it has, with no size or shape (ART-002 §5.2).
MeshConnection.title: MeshConnection

MeshWall.description: One box per layer, with rectangular voids through every layer (ART-003 §6.1). A display primitive.
MeshWall.title: MeshWall

MeshWallFramingPiece.description:
An oriented box per piece (ART-003 §6.2): through-wall along the wall's ``outward_xy``, in-plane in the
wall's plane across the axis. No key and no ``primitive`` field (D086).
MeshWallFramingPiece.title: MeshWallFramingPiece

PlanConnection.description: A connection marker on the entering member's plane (ART-002 §4.2). Members are listed by the schedule.
PlanConnection.title: PlanConnection

PlanHorizontalPiece.description: A girt, header, rough sill, buck head, or buck sill: the plan projection of its axis (D086).
PlanHorizontalPiece.title: PlanHorizontalPiece

PlanLinearMember.description: Every role but posts: the plan projection of the member's axis (ART-002 §4.1).
PlanLinearMember.title: PlanLinearMember

PlanVerticalPiece.description: A stud, king, jack, cripple, or buck jamb: the plan projection of its start. No key or section (D086).
PlanVerticalPiece.title: PlanVerticalPiece

PlanWall.description: A wall's outline: the band from start to end, ``exterior_m`` outward and ``interior_m`` inward (D070, D083).
PlanWall.title: PlanWall

PlanWallOpening.description: A gap through the wall's full thickness at the rough opening, along its reference line (ART-003 §5.2).
PlanWallOpening.title: PlanWallOpening

PriceBook.description: A project's price book as submitted (book-level metadata, artifacts.md §8.2).
PriceBook.title: Price book (artifacts.md §8.2)

WallFramingLine.description: One line per wall framing kind and section in use, priced per meter, with its count beside (D070).
WallFramingLine.title: WallFramingLine

WallLayerSpan.description: A layer's signed interval along the wall's outward normal, 0 at the reference plane (D083).
WallLayerSpan.title: WallLayerSpan

WallVoid.description: A rough opening in wall-local coordinates: ``u`` along the wall from its start, ``v`` up from its base.
WallVoid.title: WallVoid
